name: Mabel
description: Mabel is a mousefolk baker and swordswoman of Goodhill, a mother and Clem's wife, who leads the party that returns the Calamity Beast egg.

status.text: As of the latest story Mabel is a resident of Bloomburrow who sees a shadow of her home and her littles in the second world as the worlds begin to overlay.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Mabel, on her birthday in Goodhill, is pressed by Mayor Oliver to bring out her family relic.
timeline.quote: Perhaps this would be an appropriate occasion to bring out that old relic you have tucked away in your attic

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel saves her tumbling children, and Clem returns to the household.
timeline.quote: With one paw, she slung Pip onto her shoulder

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Jenefer reports a stranger in Pond Creek, and Mabel grabs her rapier.
timeline.quote: "There's a stranger in Pond Creek, and she don't look well at all."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The collapsed Helga tells Mabel she was attacked by a Calamity Beast, and Mabel takes her home.
timeline.quote: "Attack … Calamity Beast …"

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel decides to shelter Helga and postpone her birthday party.
timeline.quote: my birthday party will have to wait.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga wakes in Goodhill in Mabel's home after dreaming of the Night Owl and of a weaselfolk in a red hood.
timeline.quote: She'd been dreaming of the Night Owl.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga tells Mabel, Clem and Oliver about Maha's attack and the destruction of Pondside, but Oliver doubts her.
timeline.quote: Your imagination seems a touch overactive, which is to be expected of an artistic temperament.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel tells Helga that she believes her visions, and decides someone must travel to Pondside.
timeline.quote: "Someone must travel to Pondside," Mabel said.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel retrieves her family's fang-sword from the attic and its sigils glow for the first time.
timeline.quote: The sigils on the blade briefly gave off a faint reddish light

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: At the lively birthday party Helga appears in the doorway and Oliver gives his speech praising Mabel.
timeline.quote: "Neighbors—nay, friends," Oliver began

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel publicly defends Helga, announces she will go to Pondside, and reveals the fang-sword, which sheens with flame.
timeline.quote: a faint sheen of flame rippled along the carved tooth from hilt to tip.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Finneas, Hugs, Gev, Zoraline and Helga volunteer to accompany Mabel to Pondside.
timeline.quote: "You must take me, too,"

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel says goodbye to her children and Clem before leaving at first light.
timeline.quote: "You are my sweet and brave little mouselings, and I will love you from spring to winter and back again."

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The party departs Goodhill for Pondside amid fanfare.
timeline.quote: the party departed for Pondside.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: On the road Gev tells a tall tale of the Striped Rapscallions, which Mabel says is his way of coping.
timeline.quote: the stories are Gev's way of coping.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruins of Pondside and Hugs and Mabel read tracks showing the villagers went south toward Haymeadow.
timeline.quote: Haymeadow, likely. It's closer than Goodhill.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The necromancers raise skeletons and the party fights them.
timeline.quote: dozens of gleaming eyes surrounded the Goodhill delegation.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga makes water steps so Mabel can reach the birds, but loses control of the spell; Mabel still kills the skeleton.
timeline.quote: With a sound like a bubble popping, the stairs fell to splatter the soil.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The necromancers flee toward the Long River, and the party decides to follow them to Three Tree City.
timeline.quote: "We follow the squirrelfolk," she said. "To Three Tree."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Otterfolk carry the party by boat to Three Tree City's Docklands.
timeline.quote: They arrived at the Docklands beneath the drooping tendrils of the willow

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel meets Ral Zarek, an otterfolk hunting Jace Beleren, who grabs Helga after seeing her drawing.
timeline.quote: "Ral," he replied. "Ral Zarek. I'm looking for someone named Jace Beleren."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The river surges and the Flood Gar, a Calamity Beast, attacks the Docklands.
timeline.quote: "The Flood Gar!" Helga screamed.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: A great wave sweeps the party into the Long River where Hugs keeps everyone afloat.
timeline.quote: Mabel sucked in a deep breath and clung to Hugs

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The current slows and the party washes ashore in a marshy cave, where hooded ratfolk surround them and tell them to leave.
timeline.quote: "Outsiders," a ratfolk hissed. "You are not welcome here.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The party is surrounded by ratfolk in a cavern, but elder Coffey calls them guests and invites them in.
timeline.quote: "The River brought them to us. We must offer them hospitality."

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Coffey explains they are lorekeepers who preserve Bloomburrow's history.
timeline.quote: We preserve the history of Bloomburrow and Valley within it.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel resolves to find whoever commands Cruelclaw and return the egg to its place.
timeline.quote: "Then we return the egg to its rightful place."

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga attempts an augury with a basin of water, and after calming her mind sketches Fountainport's fountain, divining Cruelclaw's destination.
timeline.quote: "They've gone to Fountainport," Helga whispered.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The party leaves the ratfolk village; Tucker warns of a strange dangerous creature near the shortcut.
timeline.quote: I'm told it's not a Calamity Beast, but it's very like one.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: On the dandelion shortcut, Ral tells Mabel he misses his husband Tomik.
timeline.quote: "I miss my husband, too."

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: A vast shadow passes and a storm gathers, revealing a four-winged lightning-wreathed dragon-hawk.
timeline.quote: A giant creature hovered in the air, purple lightning crackling across its body.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The dragon-hawk retreats into the clouds and the party shelters under a boulder with Helga's water barrier.
timeline.quote: The falling drops solidified into a thin barrier perpendicular to the rock

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel leads the group onward to Fountainport.
timeline.quote: "On we go, then," Mabel said

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga leads her companions up through Fountainport to seek an audience with King Glarb, her former master.
timeline.quote: In theory, we ask his aides for an audience.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The party is admitted to the throne room and tells King Glarb about the attacks and Cruelclaw's theft.
timeline.quote: A weaselfolk called Cruelclaw stole a Calamity Beast egg

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: King Glarb reveals his plan to control the Calamity Beast within the egg as a champion for Valley.
timeline.quote: with the right weaving, I can control the Calamity Beast within that egg.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: King Glarb binds the party and orders Cruelclaw's Direshades to kill them, mocking Helga as a failure.
timeline.quote: "Direshades, take them," Cruelclaw ordered.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga, encouraged by Mabel, uses a water-step spell to send Cruelclaw sliding into the king, breaking the bonds.
timeline.quote: With a jerk of her chin, she sent him sliding toward King Glarb

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: A battle breaks out in the throne room between the party and the Direshades.
timeline.quote: Every enemy who sought to strike her found only empty air as her magic obscured her movements.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel fights Cruelclaw, her sword bursts into flame, and she disarms him and spares his life.
timeline.quote: "Leave with your life," Mabel said.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: King Glarb freezes Helga in ice and Mabel melts it, and the king rises on a water platform as a storm gathers.
timeline.quote: jammed her flaming blade into the frozen block.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The Storm Hawk dives at King Glarb, who escapes by portal.
timeline.quote: From between streaks of electricity, the Storm Hawk emerged with a deafening roar.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel climbs Helga's water steps to the stone lily and challenges the Storm Hawk, but Maha, the Night Owl, strikes it first.
timeline.quote: struck by a new foe: Maha, the Night Owl, trailing a curtain of darkness.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel carries the egg to the Night Owl and returns it, calming the Calamity Beast.
timeline.quote: The Night Owl gingerly took the egg.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: King Glarb leaves Fountainport and Cruelclaw escapes, while the party heads home.
timeline.quote: King Glarb not only fled the immediate area, he left Fountainport entirely, his whereabouts unknown.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The returning heroes are welcomed with a parade in Goodhill, and Oliver gives another speech.
timeline.quote: treating their arrival as an impromptu parade.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga decides to stay in Goodhill as a hedgewitch and is called a hero.
timeline.quote: I thought maybe I could … stay here? As a hedgewitch

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga speaks a prophecy that the kings in the dark will return and the mage in blue will bring about the end.
timeline.quote: "The kings in the dark will return," she intoned. "The mage in blue will bring about the end."

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel gives Ral two holly-leaf buttons for him and his husband, and Ral vanishes in lightning.
timeline.quote: Ral vanished in an explosion of lightning sparks that lit the evening

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Across the Multiverse the worlds begin to overlay; on Ravnica, Bloomburrow, Amonkhet and Dominaria, people see doubles of their worlds.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, the worlds begin to overlay.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Zoraline assists Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.
timeline.quote: One of their kin, Zoraline , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts .

citation.text: "Bat", section "Bloomburrow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A ragtag team of anthropomorphic adventurers band together on a quest to save the realm from elemental calamity beasts and the Great-Night Owl.
timeline.quote: A ragtag team of anthropomorphic adventurers must band together to go on an important quest to save the realm from elemental calamity beasts and the Great-Night Owl .

citation.text: "Bloomburrow", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: It falls to Mabel and her companions Gev, Hugs, Finneas and Zoraline to redeem their world.
timeline.quote: It is now up to Mabel and her colorful companions Gev , Hugs , Finneas , and Zoraline to redeem their world.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel's group of small warriors and misfits returns the egg, stopping the Beasts.
timeline.quote: A group of small warriors and misfits under the leadership of Mabel returned the egg, stopping the Beasts.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Calamity returns to Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel's party defeats the Direshade Company in Fountainport; they surrender or escape with their leader.
timeline.quote: After their defeat by Mabel’s party in Fountainport, they either surrendered to authorities or escaped the city with their leader.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Factions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga assisted Mabel in her quest to stop Glarb.
timeline.quote: One of Glarb's apprentices, Helga , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop him.

citation.text: "Frog", section "Bloomburrow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga escaped Pondside when Maha attacked it and warned Mabel and the people of Goodhill about the Calamity Beasts.
timeline.quote: Helga escaped Pondside when it was attacked by Maha around 4564 AR .

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga joined Mabel's party, along with Finneas, Gev, Hugs and Zoraline, to go to Pondside.
timeline.quote: Helga volunteered to accompany her because she wanted to see what happened to her homeland.

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga found her home at Pondside utterly destroyed.
timeline.quote: Helga was dismayed to find that it was utterly destroyed.

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga made a staircase of water droplets so Mabel could attack skeletal birdfolk.
timeline.quote: Helga used one of her cantrips to make a staircase of water droplets so that Mabel could attack skeletal birdfolk .

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glarb revealed he caused the Calamity Beasts' rampage by stealing Maha's egg and set Cruelclaw and mercenaries on the party.
timeline.quote: he revealed that he was the cause of the Calamity Beasts' rampage, as he had stolen Maha's egg.

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maha appeared and Mabel appeased her by returning her egg.
timeline.quote: whom Mabel appeased by returning her egg

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gev assists Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.
timeline.quote: assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts

citation.text: "Lizard", section "Bloomburrow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel joins the mousefolk defenders and drives off bandits attacking Goodhill.
timeline.quote: She joined the local band of mousefolk defenders when bandits attacked Goodhill, protecting the town and driving off the outlaws.

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga warns Mabel of the coming Calamity Beasts; Mabel takes up Cragflame and heads to Pondside with companions.
timeline.quote: she answered the call to adventure.

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek joins the party in Three Trees City, and they decide to consult King Glarb in Fountainport.
timeline.quote: Later in Three Trees City , Ral Zarek joined her party.

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glarb reveals he stole Maha's egg to tame a Calamity and sends Cruelclaw against Mabel's party.
timeline.quote: the king revealed that he was the one responsible for the Calamities' rampage

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maha appears and Mabel soothes it by returning its egg, saving the plane.
timeline.quote: Mabel soothed the beast's wrath by returning its egg, saving the plane from the wrath of the Calamities.

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel reunites with her family and gives Ral ironsap buttons before he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: At the end of her journey, she reunited with her loving family.

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, the Calamity Beasts destroy Mabel's village and she vows revenge on Glarb.
timeline.quote: In the Echoverse , her village was destroyed by the Calamity Beasts, separating her family.

timeline.summary: The party forms after Helga warns Mabel about the Calamity Beasts; Mabel fetches Cragflame and resolves to go to Pondside.
